title:
🌧️ She smiles 💫 but her eyes bleed pain,
💭 Every laugh hides 🌙 a thousand cries,
💔 And her soul whispers, he’s gone.

🌸 You’re not just in my heart 💫, you are my heart,
💖 Every thought 🌙 begins with your name,
💞 And ends with your smile.

🌧️ Smiling outside 💫, dying inside,
🥀 Hiding tears behind 💭 fake laughter,
💔 That’s how I survive every day.

🌙 You left, but your shadow stayed 💭,
💔 It haunts my nights 💫 and quiet days,
🥀 Reminding me what pain feels like.

💫 Some days 🌙 I feel alive,
💭 Other days 💔 I’m just existing,
🥀 Lost in the chaos of my own mind.

🌙 Life isn’t always 💫 what we dream,
💔 Sometimes it’s pain 💭 disguised as lessons,
🥀 And tears are the price we pay.

🌙 I loved you 💞 more than anyone,
💔 But you chose someone else 💫,
🥀 And my heart still can’t forget.

💭 Sometimes silence 💔 screams louder,
🌙 Than words ever could 💫,
🥀 Especially when love turns into pain.

🌙 You left, but your shadow stayed 💭,
💔 It haunts my nights 💫 and quiet days,
🥀 Reminding me what pain feels like.

🌿 The ocean 🌊 knows how I feel,
💭 Calm outside 💫 but deep inside storms,
💔 Waves crash just like my thoughts.

💌 In your eyes 🌙 I saw my dreams,
🌹 In your words ✨ I found peace...
🥀 Now all that’s left 💔 is a story of pain.

🌸 I wrote your name in the sky 💫,
🌧️ The rain came and erased the mark 🌙...
💭 But I could never erase you from my heart 🖤

💞 Every morning 🌙 begins with your memory,
🌸 In the moonlight 💫 I search for your face,
💖 I love you 💕 selflessly, endlessly.

🌙 I wish to lose myself 💞 in your eyes,
💫 My heart trembles 🌸 at your touch,
💖 Without you, everything feels empty.

💫 A little bit of your 🌹 love is enough,
🌙 In that love 💞 lies my whole world,
💖 When you’re here 🥰 everything feels beautiful.

💔 You said “forever” 🌙 but forever ended too soon,
🥀 I still see you 💫 in every dream,
💭 but you’re nowhere in my reality.

💭 I lost you 💔 trying to keep us together,
🌙 Now I’m holding pain 💫 instead of you,
🥀 and smiling just to hide the scars.

💫 In your arms 🌙 I find my heaven,
💖 Every heartbeat whispers your name 💞,
🌹 You’re my forever 🥀 dream come true.

🌧️ You’re gone 💭 but your memories stay,
🥀 They whisper your name 🌙 every night,
💔 and tear me apart 💫 in silence.

🌙 I wish love 💫 was enough to keep you,
💔 But wishes don’t heal 💭 broken hearts,
🥀 they only make the pain poetic.
